arguments.content: Protocol rollout review pattern (enhanced-settings client, 2026-10-10; code-reviewer P1, corroborated by external reviewer): Replacing the only baseline-response mock with a future-provider response can leave a green suite while ordinary operations become incompatible. Review request additions AND post-write response requirements against the supported provider release, not just pending task scope. In the receipt change, eval-release persisted settings and returned ok=true, then the client raised because applied was absent even with enhanced_settings=false. Preserve the legacy path until receipt mode/capability is active and test both persisted state and the caller-visible result against the supported release. Pending provider work does not justify a regression in the current client increment.
